section1.title: 1. Acceptance of the Terms
section1.content: By contracting or using Lead Awaker’s services, the client confirms that they have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions in full. If the client does not agree with any provision, they must refrain from using the services.

section2.title: 2. Description of the Services
section2.content: Lead Awaker provides B2B services focused on automated messaging via WhatsApp, SMS, and Instagram, supported by Artificial Intelligence, primarily aimed at lead reactivation, appointment scheduling, and automated communications. The specific scope of services, pricing model, campaign duration, and objectives may vary depending on the client’s industry and the commercial agreement established between the parties.

section3.title: 3. Client Responsibilities
section3.content: The client is solely responsible for the origin, legality, and legitimacy of the leads provided, as well as for the commercial content, products, and services promoted. The client represents that they have a valid legal basis to contact the leads and that all applicable laws and platform policies are respected. The client remains responsible for compliance with data protection, consumer, and marketing regulations. Where the client supplies contact data for a campaign, the client is responsible for establishing and, on request, evidencing a valid basis for electronic marketing contact for each segment supplied, under the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR) in the United Kingdom or the equivalent national implementation of the ePrivacy Directive in the European Union. Lead Awaker may decline to send to any contact or segment for which that basis has not been provided.

section4.title: 4. Lead Awaker Responsibilities
section4.content: Lead Awaker is responsible for the technical and operational execution of the services, including system configuration, automation, and use of Artificial Intelligence as agreed. Lead Awaker undertakes not to intentionally create unlawful, abusive, or offensive content. Lead Awaker does not make business decisions on behalf of the client and is not responsible for the client’s commercial strategies or decisions, except where expressly agreed.

section5.title: 5. Results and Performance
section5.content: Unless expressly agreed otherwise in writing, Lead Awaker's services constitute an obligation of means and not an obligation of results. Lead Awaker does not guarantee any particular number of replies, appointments, sales or revenue, because the outcome depends on factors outside its control, including the quality and age of the client's data, the client's own offer and pricing, and the client's handling of the conversations that result. Where the agreed commercial model is performance-based, the practical effect is that if the campaign produces nothing, there is nothing to invoice.

section6.title: 6. Fees and Payment Terms
section6.content: All fees are agreed in writing between the parties before work begins. Lead Awaker's standard model is performance-based compensation: an agreed share of the value of sales that result from the campaign, invoiced only once the client has been paid by the customer. No setup fee, onboarding fee, recurring fee or other charge is payable unless it has been expressly agreed in writing in advance, and other structures such as recurring or campaign-based pricing are available only where the parties expressly agree them. Unless otherwise stated, there are no penalties for cancellation. Refunds, if applicable, shall follow the terms expressly agreed between the parties.

Lead Awaker has no control over the policies, availability, limitations, suspensions, or account restrictions imposed by such platforms and shall not be liable for disruptions, blocks, or bans resulting from actions or decisions taken by these third parties.

section9.content: Lead Awaker reserves the right to suspend or terminate services at any time if it identifies unlawful use, breach of these Terms, violation of applicable laws, or non-compliance with third-party platform policies. section10.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Lead Awaker shall not be liable for indirect damages, loss of profits, loss of business opportunities, account suspensions by third parties, or consequential damages arising from the use of the services. section13.title: 12. Data Protection
section13.content: Where Lead Awaker processes personal data on behalf of a client, the client acts as the Data Controller and Lead Awaker acts as a Data Processor. That relationship is governed by a separate written data processing agreement, signed by both parties before any personal data is loaded or any message is sent. The data processing agreement sets out the permitted processing, the security measures, the authorised sub-processors, breach notification, assistance with data subject rights, and deletion or return of data at the end of the engagement. Where its terms conflict with these Terms and Conditions on data protection, the data processing agreement prevails. How Lead Awaker handles personal data more generally is described in the Privacy Policy.
